summary: A creative with a fine arts background and a decade working in the film industry as a Standby Painter, Lead Props Painter, and Art Assistant. Known for my strong work ethic, keen eye for visual detail, and hands-on practical skills, I bring both precision and adaptability to every project. I enjoy planning, problem-solving and the diversity of the Art Department. Friendly and collaborative by nature, I'm a calm & solutions-focused presence - whether in the workshop, on set, or on location. You can view my work and full filmography on my website.

skills.heading: Film & On-Set
items: 7+ years of experience as a Standby Painter on a range of film & television productions
Comfortable working on-set as part of the Art Department, I'm attentive & always ready to jump in and contribute with resetting props, set dec & greens dressing, or working with performers
Skilled at working quickly, accurately, & calmly under pressure & within tight shooting schedules
Strong problem-solving abilities & flexible, adaptive responses to last-minute changes & on-set requests
Excellent cross-department communication skills - professional, friendly, & clear
Familiar with call sheets, re-sets, & continuity

skills.heading: Workshop - Painting & Finishing
items: Extensive experience painting props, sets, weapons, armour, miniatures, and costumes to a screen-ready standard
Wide range of painting techniques: wood graining, marbling, rock, rust, aging effects, metal effects, gilding, decorative, & sign writing
Experienced with tools such as airbrush, spray gun, stencils, wood grainers, sponge & spritzers.

Strong knowledge of materials, paints, coatings, & adhesives, with an understanding of their appropriate use across different substrates including flexible stunt props, foam, urethane, silicone, fabric, leather and metal.
Experienced in colour matching, layering, and texture building for hyper-realistic finishes
Excellent hand-painting ability with a focus on fine detail
Familiar with minor prop fabrication
Organised, tidy, and safety-conscious with thorough understanding of health & safety protocols

skills.heading: Organization & Teamwork
items: Experience managing small teams & overseeing workshop operations, including delegation & workflow coordination
Skilled in material and prop sourcing within budget and timeline
Strong attention to quality control, ensuring all outputs meet high creative and technical standards
Confident working independently or collaboratively, with a proactive and solution-focused approach to team dynamics

skills.heading: Digital Tools & Administration
items: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Procreate - proficient
MS Office, Google Docs/Sheets - Intermediate
Monday, Trello - proficient
Experience with petty cash, purchase orders, & accounting processes
QTAKE & Continuity
